description: Get the full public record for one published connector by its slug (the last part of https://grokbot.tools/connectors/{slug}): summary, install method with step-by-step instructions and sources, MCP URL (null for built-in plugins), auth type, docs link, Grok Bot test status with the last test date, notes, related wishlist requests, and the page URL. Status is never 'Verified' unless it was verified inside Grok Bot with a dated test. Read-only.

slug.description: Connector slug, e.g. 'notion', 'linear', 'context7'. Find slugs with search_connectors.

name: get_connector
title: Get one Grok Bot connector
